newsitem.title: CHINA: CHINA TO CONTINUE STOCK MARKET EXPANSION - PAPER.
newsitem.headline: CHINA TO CONTINUE STOCK MARKET EXPANSION - PAPER.

text.p: China will continue to expand its fledgling stock markets with the aim to support major state enterprises, the Shanghai Securities News on Thursday quoted a senior official as saying.

"In the future, (China) will take another step to expand the scale of the stock markets," the newspaper quoted Zhang Haoruo, vice minister of the State Commission for Restructuring Economy as telling a seminar in Beijing on Wednesday.
Special support would be given to major state firms with promising prospects, Zhang said.
Beijing would also further promote the development of the debt markets and investment funds, the newspaper said. It gave no further details.
